providers.vertex_prompts.field.project_i.note: Required nonsecret Google Cloud project identifier after OAuth succeeded but no active project was discovered. Field label used in TUI title, empty placeholder and submitted receipt, CLI/Desktop question. Keep Google Cloud product name.

providers.vertex_prompts.field.service_a.note: Masked service-account paste prompt field label; accepts raw JSON or a local JSON file path, NOT an API key. JSON remains technical vocabulary. Used in TUI title, empty placeholder and receipt.

providers.vertex_prompts.hint.required.note: Required login field: Enter submits a nonempty value; empty Enter or Esc cancels the entire login (not optional skip-paste). Enter/Esc name physical keys and must remain recognizable. No browser remains pending. TUI truncates to current content width; no fixed width budget.

providers.vertex_prompts.prompt.field.note: CLI required-field question. {field} is an already-localized field label (Google Cloud project ID), not a secret or user input. Empty submission cancels login. Trailing space separates terminal input from prompt; preserve it. Desktop uses only the localized field label because its input endpoint rejects empty submissions and exposes a separate cancel action.
